title: ‘Dunkman’: How Shaquille O’Neal Made Dunk Contests Great Again
content: Shaquille O’Neal loves solving problems. The basketball icon and four-time NBA champion, 54, has two master’s degrees, a doctorate, served as a sheriff’s deputy and honorary U.S. Marshal, and once played for Doc Rivers.
